en: Which figure of speech is this? “Her smile was as bright as the sun.”

example.q_en: Which figure of speech is this? “Her smile was as bright as the sun.”
example.why_en: It compares two things using “like” or “as”, so it is a simile.

en.title: Figures of speech
en.teach: Writers paint pictures with words. A simile uses like or as, a metaphor says one thing is another, personification makes things act human, alliteration repeats first sounds, and onomatopoeia sounds like the noise.
